description: Horse Magnifier is a game where you lenses on horses to magnify them.

V0.0.1.description:
The first full release of the Horse Magnifier Archipelago!
Items to receive include the 10 different lenses, the apple, the horsefly swatter, and an added horse macguffin to unlock the last level.
Locations to check include beating and (optionally) perfecting each level.
V0.0.1.title: Horse Magnifier Archipelago V0.0.1

V1.0.0.description:
Added several features:

Traps: A percentage of the junk in your item pool can be replaced with traps.
-Grenade Trap: Resets the level you are on.
-Jumpscare Trap: A horse comes to say hello.

Deathlink: Whenever someone dies, you are sent one of the prior mentioned traps.

Leniency: Reduce how perfect you need to be to send perfection checks.

More horse adjacent creatures added for junk.

Location names for levels 1-9  have had leading 0s added to help with alphabetical sorting.

General bug fixes.
V1.0.0.title: Horse Magnifier Archipelago V1.0.0

V1.1.0.description:
Added Universal Tracker YAML-less tracking support.
Added Centaurs and Kelpies to horse adjacent junk.
Mod now unlocks all levels.
V1.1.0.title: Horse Magnifier Archipelago V1.1.0
